value.rationale: The defect concerns the paper’s central mechanism for systematic exploration: the auxiliary problem is explicitly intended to provide interior restarts. On the simplest admissible compact convex set, both cell solves return the existing generators, so negative slack does not deliver a new exploration location. The distinction is structural rather than cosmetic, and the standard all-facet Chebyshev-center model gives a mathematically natural route to repair the certificate.
